title: Code for Image embeddings add limited predictive value to metadata in two NFT collections
description: Metadata correction to the frozen September 2026 BAYC/MAYC revision release: all three manuscript authors are listed as creators in this Zenodo record and CITATION.cff. DATA_ACCESS.md retains the DuneSQL query and its fixed-snapshot caveat. Modelling code, aggregate results and scientific conclusions are unchanged from v4.0.2. Raw transaction data, NFT images, embeddings, fitted models and row-level predictions remain excluded; full numerical refitting requires the documented inputs. Public tests do not constitute an independent full-data replication.
